<style>
.measure-table { overflow-x: auto; }
.measure-table th, .measure-table td { padding: .35rem .6rem; }
</style>

```{r}
#| label: report-sections
#| results: asis

.libPaths(unique(c(params$library_paths, .libPaths())))
sections <- readRDS(params$sections)

# Keep sample identifiers and user-supplied headings literal in both formats.
literal <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[\r\n]+", " ", as.character(x))
  vapply(strsplit(enc2utf8(x), "", fixed = TRUE), function(chars) {
    punct <- grepl("[[:punct:][:cntrl:]]", chars)
    chars[punct] <- sprintf("&#%d;", utf8ToInt(paste0(chars[punct], collapse = "")))
    paste0(chars, collapse = "")
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

display_column <- function(x) {
  if (is.matrix(x)) {
    x <- apply(x, 1L, paste, collapse = ", ")
  } else if (is.list(x)) {
    x <- vapply(x, function(row) paste(as.character(row), collapse = ", "), character(1))
  } else if (is.double(x) && !is.object(x)) {
    fractional <- is.finite(x) & x != trunc(x)
    x[fractional] <- signif(x[fractional], digits = 6L)
  }
  literal(x)
}

for (name in names(sections)) {
  section <- sections[[name]]
  heading <- literal(name)
  cat("## ", heading, "\n\n", sep = "")

  if (!is.data.frame(section)) {
    cat("![", heading, "](", section, ")\n\n", sep = "")
  } else if (!nrow(section) || !ncol(section)) {
    cat("No data.\n\n")
  } else {
    align <- ifelse(vapply(section, is.numeric, logical(1)), "r", "l")
    section[] <- lapply(section, display_column)
    names(section) <- literal(names(section))
    cat("::: {.measure-table}\n\n")
    print(knitr::kable(section, format = "pipe", align = align, escape = FALSE, row.names = FALSE))
    cat("\n:::\n\n")
  }
}
```
